description: This file defines a final class 'ScreenController' that manages a web view ('WKWebView'), handles URL navigation, injects JavaScript for status updates, captures snapshots, and manages deep links and actions within an iOS application. It encapsulates logic for interacting with web content in a controlled manner, including sandboxing and URL normalization.

classes.name: ScreenController
classes.description: A final class responsible for managing a web-based UI component within an iOS app, including loading URLs, injecting JavaScript, handling debug/status updates, capturing snapshots, and managing web view lifecycle events.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the web view to a specified URL string, with optional trust for A2UI actions. Handles URL validation, normalization, and special treatment for loopback URLs.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the current web view content based on the current urlString, loading from file or network as appropriate.

methods.name: showDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Resets the URL to a default scaffold URL and reloads.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status overlay or feature, applying the change to the web view.

methods.name: updateDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates the debug status title and subtitle, and applies the changes.

methods.name: applyDebugStatusIfNeeded
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into the web view to apply current debug status settings.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Sets the home canvas state JSON and applies it to the web view.

methods.name: applyHomeCanvasStateIfNeeded
methods.description: Injects JavaScript into the web view to render the home canvas state.

methods.name: waitForA2UIReady
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for the A2UI to be ready within a specified timeout.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the context of the web view and returns the result as a string.

methods.name: snapshotPNGBase64
methods.description: Captures a PNG snapshot of the current web view content and returns a base64 encoded string.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a snapshot in specified format (PNG or JPEG) with optional quality, returns base64 string.

methods.name: snapshotImage
methods.description: Internally captures a UIImage snapshot of the current web view, optionally with a max width.

methods.name: attachWebView
methods.description: Attaches a WKWebView instance to the controller and initializes its state.

methods.name: detachWebView
methods.description: Detaches the specified WKWebView from the controller if it is the active one.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasUIURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a trusted URL for the canvas UI, comparing against the scaffold or trusted remote URL.

methods.name: parseA2UIActionBody
methods.description: Static method to parse the body of an A2UI action from different possible JSON representations.
